classification: provider-issued public DNS plan; pending zone-owner application and validation
application_rules: The DNS zone owner must review and apply these exact public records; this repository does not have zone credentials.
Do not change the Sites access policy or NEXT_PUBLIC_MARKETPLACE_MODE while DNS validation is pending.
Do not deploy the direct Wrangler production routes while these hostnames are attached to Sites; select one production routing owner before public launch.
After DNS propagation, refresh both Sites custom domains and require active provider and SSL status before any launch attestation.
Run npm run domain:dns:verify and then the authenticated deployment verifier against both hostnames.
Keep the domain launch gate pending until DNS, TLS, access control, redirects, headers, robots, sitemap and named infrastructure approval are all evidenced.
